Good food and reasonable price
Dec 2023 • Friends
I always crave chicken when I visit Vietnam. I think the chicken is better than the ones here in the States. My cousin suggested to try this Pho Ga restaurant. I was told it was pretty well known in Saigon and it is always busy. So we got there around 8pm. The restaurant was still full with customers. We were lucky that we got a table for 8 right away. We ordered mostly Mien Ga (mung bean clear noodle) chicken salad, chicken parts, etc. The services were pretty fast so we got our orders in couple minutes. The chicken was cooked perfectly. The chicken salad was delicious even though we did add some salt and peppers to bring out the taste. However, my brother did not like the soup that much as we used to clear broth!!!

The price seems reasonable and the food was good. Give it a try.

Best chicken pho!
Aug 2023 • Couples
I didn't expect chicken pho to be this bloody good. After trying their broth, it really opened my eyes to how good their pho is as I've always had beef pho as other chicken pho was usually plain.

This place is a gem and they're insanely busy yet able to pump out your dish in a timely manner. Their system works and I can only highly recommend for you to eat here if you're contemplating due to the high volume of customers.

Don't stress as they will find you a seat in no time since they do both dine in and heaps of takeaway.

Very reasonable price for a bowl so you can easily eat two bowls for a bargain if you're a traveler outside of the locals.

One of the Best Pho Ga I've Eaten
Apr 2017 • Couples
Although a bit difficult to find at first, it was definitely worth it. The restaurant itself has plenty of seating and has an open kitchen. When I was there, pricing for a bowl of Pho Ga was approximately 40,000 VND, or about $2 USD per bowl. I wish I would've known at the time, but for 5,000 VND more you can get a large bowl. 

The flavor depth of the broth was sublime. They provide you with a side of salt/pepper. You're supposed to mix it with some lime and also hot sauce. The flavor of the sauce is a winning combination when dipped and really gives the meal the "it" factor IMHO. The sauce is actually so good, I've decided to name it the "crack sauce" because it was so good and addicting. 

Local spot that I'll definitely be coming back to next time in Saigon.
